description: This file defines data models, request payloads, and validation logic for asset management within a backend system, including asset DTOs, create/update/delete request classes, and query parameters.

classes.name: AssetDto
classes.description: Represents a persisted asset record mapping to the database table 'asset'.

classes.name: CreateAssetRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates the payload for creating a new asset, including validation logic for process group text.

classes.name: UpdateAssetRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates the payload for updating an existing asset, sharing similar validation logic to creation requests.

classes.name: DeleteAssetRequest
classes.description: Contains fields for soft-deleting an asset via audit/trace fields.

classes.name: QueryAssetsRequest
classes.description: Holds optional filter parameters for querying assets, supporting multiple criteria.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validation method in CreateAssetRequest and UpdateAssetRequest to ensure 'Other' process group text is provided when necessary.
